ios.desc:
Introducing Remind There – the ultimate app for managing your geofenced reminders seamlessly on iOS. Designed to enhance your productivity, Remind There allows you to create, view, and organize location-based reminders with ease.

Key Features:
- Simple Reminder Creation: Effortlessly set reminders that trigger when you arrive at or leave specific locations.
- Intuitive Interface: A clean, user-friendly design ensures quick access to all your reminders.
- Custom Geofencing: Define precise geofenced areas for tailored notifications, whether it’s your home, office, or favorite café.
- Real-Time Updates: Stay informed with timely alerts based on your current location.
- Seamless Integration: Works smoothly with your iOS ecosystem, ensuring stability and reliability.

Never forget to pick up groceries near the supermarket or call a friend when you’re in the neighborhood. With Remind There, your tasks are always where you need them to be—right when you need them.

quotes.text:
Geofenced reminders are great, but quite a hassle to set up in iOS.

Remind There simplifies and makes it more fun to use geofenced reminders on iOS!
